# The Trichotomy Theorem {#sec-theorem}

One theorem, stated once, across the tower of strata from @sec-model.
Two previously separate results — `EON` and `EALM` — are corollaries of
it, not independent theorems requiring their own proofs.

Fix an entry alphabet $R$, a commitment $\Gamma$ whose components sit at
stratum $Q$, and a claim $\Claim$ over $R$. The statements below hold
above the verification floor (@sec-floor).

::: {.theorem}
**`TT-snap`$(Q)$.** $\Claim$ admits a snapshot-sound scheme with a
$Q$-verifier **iff** $\Det(\Claim)$ holds and $\phihat$ is $Q$-certifiable.
:::

::: {.theorem}
**`TT-end`$(Q)$.** $\Claim$ admits an enduring-sound scheme with a
$Q$-verifier **iff** $\Det(\Claim)$ holds, $\phihat$ is $Q$-certifiable,
and $\Mono(\Claim)$ holds.
:::

`TT-end` is `TT-snap` plus monotonicity — the only new demand an
enduring guarantee places on a claim already checkable at a snapshot.
Both directions of both biconditionals are proved, not merely the
direction that is intuitive: the $\Leftarrow$ leg *constructs* an
evidence scheme from the three conditions, which is what licenses
calling the count of conditions exhaustive (@sec-factorization) rather
than a taxonomy asserted from the outside.

## Per-stratum status

The tower is graded honestly. Some cells are proved at every stratum
this paper claims; two are open holes still being closed by the
mechanization this paper's Lean artifact is drawn from; the polynomial
stratum is conjectural throughout.

| flavor $\times$ stratum | verifier condition | status |
|---|---|---|
| snapshot $\times$ oracle | none | proved |
| enduring $\times$ oracle | none | proved (unfibered packaging pending — TODO) |
| snapshot $\times$ computable | commitment components computable | TODO — pending mechanization |
| enduring $\times$ computable | + verification-certificate predicate computable | proved |
| snapshot/enduring $\times$ polynomial | polynomial time/size | open (conjectured) |

The two `TODO` cells are small, mechanical gaps against an already-proved
neighbor, not open mathematical questions: the oracle-stratum enduring
result currently exists only as an assembly of four separate lemmas
rather than one packaged theorem, and the computable-stratum snapshot
result is an unmechanized port of a shape already proved one stratum up.
Both are expected to close before this paper's next revision; neither
bears on the truth of the theorem as stated, only on whether a reader
can point at a single Lean declaration for it. The polynomial stratum is
different in kind: it is stated as a conjecture because the corresponding
theorems have not been proved at all, and the paper says so rather than
implying three proved strata where one is open.

## Corollaries

**The determination gate.** Contrapositive of `TT-snap`$(Q)$'s first
conjunct: a claim that is not record-determined admits no scheme, at any
stratum, of any soundness flavor. This is the trichotomy's most basic
consequence and the reason two cells of the cell table (@sec-cell-table)
are empty by theorem rather than by omission.

**`EALM`.** `TT-end`$(\oracle)$, presented fibered — the determination
and certifiability conjuncts supplied as hypotheses rather than stated
independently. No new content beyond the one theorem above; only a
different packaging, oriented toward a reader who already has a
determined, certifiable claim in hand and wants to know exactly what
monotonicity buys.

**`EON`.** The contrapositive of `TT-end`$(Q)$'s forward direction, at a
claim known to be non-monotone: no enduring scheme exists at any
stratum. Where `EALM` answers "what do I need, additionally, for
endurance," `EON` answers "what do I lose, permanently, once endurance
is known to fail."

A companion theorem — the **verification ceiling** — generalizes the
gate above from append-only records specifically to any well-founded
justification structure. It is introduced in @sec-instances, where it is
instantiated twice, and its relationship to the theorem above is stated
precisely there: it shares the gate, but its completeness and minimality
content is its own machinery, over a disjoint vocabulary, and is not a
corollary of `TT-snap`/`TT-end` in the sense the paragraphs above are.
